messages:
alex: Quick sync on yesterday's regression and follow-ups. Postmortem is here: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0319>. High level asks: assign remediation owners, agree temporary mitigations, and decide the new service targets we want enforced in dashboards/alerts. I’m proposing: p95 <= 120ms, throughput floor 400rps, weekly error budget burn cap 2%. Thoughts?

marie: Ack. I can own dashboard changes + alert tuning. Plan: add p95 + p99 panels, add a traffic-split heatmap, and tag panels with owner. ETA: 2026-04-02. Will post a grafana JSON PR.

ravi: I’ll take the routing-layer remediation (circuit-breaker + safer fallback). Break into PR1 (circuit-breaker) and PR2 (fallback & retries). Estimates: PR1 by 2026-04-09, PR2 by 2026-04-23. Interim ask: can we rate-limit low-priority requests to keep tail latency down?

jen: Agreed on the interim rate-limit. I’ll update the on-call runbook to include the mitigation steps and the rollback criteria. ETA: 2026-03-30.

sam: From infra side I can provision a temporary GPU buffer (1x small pool) during the rollout window. Need finance approval for 30 days — pinged @finance. If approved, I can have it ready by 2026-03-28.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0319 closed. Post-incident metric updates: error budget change -0.6%. Current burn rate: 3.2%/week. Alert: will fire if >5% in 7d.

alex: For the dashboards/alerts, suggested alert rule (draft): WHEN p95(request_latency) > 120ms for 3m OR error_rate > 1% for 5m -> page. Also add a warning channel for >80ms so we can catch regressions early.

ravi: Quick note — our histogram metric is request_latency_seconds_bucket (not request_latency). Example PromQL for p95: ```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))``` We should exclude warmup spikes; consider using [10m] for stability.

marie: Thanks, ravi. I’ll use that exact PromQL and set the alert expression to evaluate on 3m windows. Alert thresholds we agreed: p95 > 120ms (page), p99 > 250ms (page), p95 > 100ms (warn). I’ll add an annotations section with runbook links.

alex: Owners & deadlines summary (adding to postmortem):
- marie: dashboards + alert rules + grafana PR by 2026-04-02
- jen: runbook + oncall playbook edits by 2026-03-30
- ravi: routing PR1 (circuit-breaker) by 2026-04-09; PR2 (fallback/retries) by 2026-04-23
- sam: temp GPU pool provisioning by 2026-03-28 (pending finance)
I’ll update the incident doc and tag owners.

jen: Can we also track whether this is part of a recurring pattern? I’m seeing similar tail-latency spikes every ~2 weeks in the incident log. I’ll schedule a weekly check-in for 4 weeks to review trends.

marie: Good idea. I’ll add a dashboard band that shows weekly incident counts + annotations for each outage. Also will add an ‚recurring-incident‘ panel to correlate deployment tags and latency spikes.

alex: Quick snippet for dashboard annotation automation (Grafana API example): ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://grafana.redwood/api/annotations -d '{"time": 1610000000000, "text":"INC-2026-0319", "tags":["latency","regression"]}'```

sam: Finance replied in the ticket — provisional approval for 30 days granted. I’ll start provisioning and post the pool names here once ready.

alex: Great. Final notes: add a 'service-targets' tag to the incident doc and dashboards, set automated weekly SLO digest to the eng-sre channel, and run the 4-week follow-up cadence starting next Monday. I’ll call out a post-checkin in the ops sync. :thumbsup:
